chunks: What was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Sālim, from Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr, from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would stand in line with the navel of a man, and for women lower than that, toward the chest.

key_terms.أَدْوَنَ: lower than that; indicating a lower standing position
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the male deceased over whom the funeral prayer is performed
key_terms.السُّرَّةِ: the navel; the point aligned with the standing position for a man
key_terms.الصَّدْرِ: the chest; the area toward which one stands for a woman
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women; referring to the female deceased
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, whose practice is being reported
key_terms.يَقُومُ: would stand; indicates his physical position during the rite

ai.seo_question: Where should one stand when performing the funeral prayer over a man or a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding where to stand in relation to the جنازة during the funeral prayer. It indicates a difference between the position for a male deceased and a female deceased, serving as guidance in prayer rulings.
